tests.name: AskUserQuestion exposes a merge question contract

manual.reason: No automated assertion asserts the absence of the merge key in isolation; the byte-identical claim rests on the retained pre-existing frame-shape test plus the field being an Option that is only emitted when present.
manual.steps: Ask a two-option question with no merge field and dump the askUser frame produced by AgentActor.buildAskUserJson.
manual.expected: The frame contains no merge key on items[0] and is byte-identical to the pre-change shape.

tests.name: merge configuration survives parse and JSON answer stays intact

manual.reason: The secret-plus-merge parse path has no dedicated test in this change; the guard is the single expression that clears merge when secret is set, verified by reading the parse branch.
manual.steps: Parse one question carrying secret: true together with a merge object and inspect the resulting AskItem.
manual.expected: The AskItem has secret = true and merge = None; no exception is raised for the whole card.

tests.name: merge configuration is forwarded in the ask event
merge answer reaches the model through the real hub and answer bridge
merge configuration survives parse and JSON answer stays intact
